text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as we continue Nishino Flower's specialized short-distance training in preparation for the Sprinters Stakes…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, has Flower gotten even faster? She's aiming for the Sprinters Stakes, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: With speed like that, she could hold her own against students in their senior year, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew… How did I do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I did? But I felt like I lost a bit of speed at the end there…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm still lacking in stamina. It might be a good idea for me to strengthen my body some more, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can tell that Nishino Flower is lacking in confidence. It seems like she hasn't put her performance in the Japanese Oaks behind her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The good news is that she's becoming faster by the day. But how do I get her to realize that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aha! I think it was around here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well, well! Who was it that called for me?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O? You said someone called you here?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm? I could have sworn I heard someone say "with speed like that, she could hold her own against students in their senior year."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And everyone knows speed is synonymous with Bakushin! Raise your hand if you're the one who called me! No need to be shy now!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So, this is the final stop along the wind's currents… Please allow me to join you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're here too, Zephyr? Umm…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O and Yamanin Zephyr have both declared that they'll be running in the Sprinters Stakes. In other words, they're Nishino Flower's rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These two have already achieved great results in sprints and mile races. If Nishino Flower can run well against them, it's sure to boost her confidence.
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask you two…

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O and Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (They really are just as fast as I imagined! It's like they're on a whole different level… But!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to catch up to them! Raaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No way… Did I… actually win?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She blew past like a searing gale…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! Now that was some impressive speed! Nice Bakushin, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: D-do you think so? Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Allow me to express my own thanks as well. The Sprinters Stakes has become even more enticing now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! Wait, you two are also entering that race?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No! But I do now! And I won't lose on the big day, that's for sure!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower nods with strong determination. It looks like she's built up a bit of confidence in herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's evening and we've wrapped up our training session. Next, I should…
choice_data_list: Find a way to build power for incline running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes will be held at Nakayama Racecourse. Nishino Flower will need strength to overcome the steep slope right before the finish line.
choice_data_list: (I could really use some advice, though…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: La, la, laaa! ♪ Bath time, bath time…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Correct. My father instructed me in the application of this training method.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's Bourbon with… Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to consult with Mihono Bourbon since I was sure she'd have some valuable input on power training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Those are the key points of ramp training. In Flower's case, I recommend keeping the physical load at fifty percent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Please do your best for Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's still hard at work for my sake.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then I also need to…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What matters at the end of a race is willpower. Encouragement from the crowd can provide a spark, so I decide to learn the best cheering methods.
choice_data_list: (I could really use some advice, though…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: La, la, laaa! ♪ Bath time, bath time…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Once she hears something like that, she'll be bursting with energy!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's Biko with… Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to consult with Biko Pegasus. As someone who's always going around helping others, I wanted to hear her thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: In the heat of a race, nothing beats hearing honest cheers that come from the heart!
choice_data_list: Thanks. You've been a big help!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A true hero is always ready and willing to lend a hand! Call on me whenever you're in a bind!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's still hard at work for my sake.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then I also need to…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After gathering advice from other Umamusume, I take a break and go for a walk outside.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There you are, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you have a moment? Right now?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, here you go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, Nishino Flower hands me a steaming rice ball and a flask containing miso soup.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A late-night snack. The staff gave me permission to use the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I thought you might be hungry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Um, I hope you don't think I'm being a busybody.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I know it's hot out tonight, but warm food is still easier on the tummy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …I'm going to give it all I have tomorrow, too. I'll definitely win my next race.
